_comment: Least-privilege IAM policy for the dedicated paid-HTTPS cert bucket. Attach to a user/role whose access key is S3_ACCESS_ID/S3_SECRET_KEY. Replace YOUR_CERT_BUCKET. Caddy (certmagic-s3, via minio-go) needs ListBucket + GetBucketLocation + object read/write/delete; the app's revoke teardown needs list + delete. The bucket should have Block Public Access ON and default encryption (SSE-S3/AES256, or SSE-KMS). If using SSE-KMS, also grant kms:GenerateDataKey and kms:Decrypt on the key.
